question: Use the quadratic formula to solve \((2x-1)(x+1)=2\).
solution: Expanding gives \(2x²+x-1=2\), which rearranges to \(2x²+x-3=0\). Then \(b²-4ac=1+24=25\) and \(x=(-1\pm5)/4\), so \(x=1\) or \(x=-3/2\).
